summary.text: Jose Javier Rodriguez is the Democratic nominee for Attorney General. A Miami attorney, he served in the Florida House (2012 to 2016) and Florida Senate (2016 to 2020), and later as a U.S. Assistant Secretary of Labor. His campaign centers on crime, costs and corruption.

paragraphs.text: Rodriguez earned a B.A. from Brown University in 2000 and a J.D. from Harvard Law School in 2006, and has worked as an attorney.

Rodriguez served in the Florida House of Representatives for District 112 before being elected to the Florida Senate for District 37, where he served from 2016 to 2020 and sat on the Ethics and Elections and Judiciary committees.
He later served as U.S. Assistant Secretary of Labor.
